cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-15: the Hadina RIMTIC incubator launched a programme for nine selected startups in October 2026 (MRT-003) and the central bank's DigiLab incubates selected teams (MRT-002), so 3 holds. InnovRIM's incubation outside Nouakchott is still planned (MRT-005), so not 4.
